item.title: Central bank holds the benchmark rate
item.content:encoded:
The central bank left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Wednesday, holding borrowing costs steady for the third consecutive meeting.

Policymakers said inflation had continued to ease but remained above the official target, and that further evidence of sustained disinflation would be required before any reduction.
